_comment: Sources for the 8x8 icons. The graphics are not stored in this repository.
Third parties uploaded them to the LaMetric community library, and some are
brand logos. Shipping them under this project's license would make a license
claim that this project cannot support.
scripts/fetch-icons.py downloads them by ID and applies the transformations.
Source for each icon: https://developer.lametric.com/icons -> ID
Operations: 'tint' recolors the silhouette through the alpha channel,
'colorize' recolors every pixel while preserving transparency,
'ramp' maps the existing shading onto a black -> color gradient,
'hue' rotates the color wheel and 'saturate' boosts it (ImageMagick
'replace' swaps one specific color for another.
